study type: Cross-sectional analysis (descriptive statistics, logistic and multinomial regressions)
outcome: Functional status of distinct energy uses (e.g., medical devices, lighting)
cohort: The participants were all health facilities in Malawi.
finding: Energy uses were less likely to be functional in facilities with lower-quality electricity supply, and despite a critical lack of functional lighting in facilities offering child delivery and night-time care, the provision of night-time care was not associated with functional lighting.
